name: opencouncil
description: Self-hosted BYOK platform where multiple LLMs convene as a council to research, deliberate, and agree.
author: Zeyad Gomaa

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,web -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.postinstall: npm run build || echo '[opencouncil] build skipped — run `npm run build` manually'
scripts.prepare: node -e "if(process.env.npm_lifecycle_event==='prepare'&&process.env.NODE_ENV!=='skip-prepare'){require('fs').existsSync('apps/server/dist/cli.js')||console.log('[opencouncil] tip: run `npm run build` to produce the CLI')}"
